component: LOS (line of sight); negative = away from satellite = subsidence
source: NISAR L2 GUNW (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 41 descending frame 78; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gunw
notes: Cumulative LOS displacement relative to 2026-06-17, sum of 9 consecutive pairs (2026-06-17_2026-06-29, 2026-06-29_2026-07-11, 2026-07-11_2026-07-23, 2026-07-23_2026-08-16, 2026-08-16_2026-08-28, 2026-08-28_2026-09-09, 2026-09-09_2026-09-21, 2026-09-21_2026-10-03, 2026-10-03_2026-10-15). Phase to cm with -lambda/(4*pi), lambda from each file's centerFrequency. Masks: coherence >= 0.3, connectedComponents != 0, isolated patches < 200 px (1.3 km2) removed (unwrapping-error guard), pixels deviating > lambda/4 (half a phase cycle) from their 720 m tile median removed, |pair| > 15.0 cm removed; pixel shown only if valid in every pair. All pairs referenced to the same window at -100.4055E 20.5451N. The ionosphere phase screen shipped in each GUNW was subtracted. A best-fit plane was removed from each pair (long-wavelength atmospheric residual; this can also remove part of any valley-wide tilt). Troposphere and solid-earth-tide layers were NOT applied; residual atmospheric noise of a few cm per pair is expected.

reference_point.source: Derived centroid of the published El Cimatario National Park boundary; park limits in CONANP/PAOT AN07.pdf; geology not independently verified

quality_note: NISAR L2 GUNW CRID P05023 provisional products only; calibration and validation are carried out by NASA-JPL/ISRO.

reference_anchor.window: 7x7; at least 48/49 common-valid pixels; nearest high-coherence window within 3 km of source locality

confidence_note: Indicative only: reference geology/out-of-basin status and independent validation are not established by this local replay.
